correctness.rationale: For n>=k>=2, m>=2 independent clauses with common fair sign coin plus p-independent sign flips, simultaneous one-clause success probability a_q(tuple) is the binary-symmetric-noise convolution of a_p with epsilon=(q-p)/(1-2p). Thus E Z_p^r=sum_tuple a_p(tuple)^m and convex Jensen plus translation-invariant summation proves every raw-moment order; restriction to distinct tuples proves weak falling-factorial order. On the diagonal tuple, changing one coordinate changes one-clause failure probability by k(1-2p)((1-p)^(k-1)-p^(k-1))/(2n)>0; for m>=2 strict Jensen applies, including q=1/2. For m=1 solution count is deterministic; k=1 p-independent. Fresh exact n=k=2,m=r=2 raw moments for p=0,1/4,1/2: 13/2,341/64,21/4. This is a finite corroboration only.
